author: JOHN CATE
title: Leak triggers Mooresburg water shortage - NewsBreak
text:
By JOHN CATE ,
7 hours ago
MOORESBURG — A water leak whose source had not been identified by publication time for this issue of the Review was causing serious issues for Mooresburg residents in the middle of the week.
The community, which receives water from the Town of Bean Station, was reporting water shortages Wednesday afternoon and sent out a bulletin online asking Mooresburg Utility District customers to conserve water. The bulletin stated that the community's water tanks were low, and many residents were stating that they had no water at all.
The leak was likely in the Bean Station water system, as that town also reported low water pressure and shortages at about 7 p.m. and stated that crews were trying to locate the source of the leak.
